title: Palace urges Dela Rosa: 'Sumuko ka na para walang dugong dadanak'
summary: Malacañang on Wednesday called on Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa to surrender to authorities to avoid bloodshed, and took a swipe at the group coddling the lawmaker-fugitive.
